name: raw-=
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name = 'other' RETURN id(n) AS id ORDER BY id

name: wrapped-=
query: MATCH (n) WHERE toLower(toString(coalesce(n.caller_class,''))) = 'example.other' RETURN id(n) AS id ORDER BY id

name: raw-CONTAINS
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' RETURN id(n) AS id ORDER BY id

name: wrapped-CONTAINS
query: MATCH (n) WHERE toLower(toString(coalesce(n.caller_class,''))) CONTAINS 'example.other' RETURN id(n) AS id ORDER BY id

name: raw-STARTS WITH
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name STARTS WITH 'other' RETURN id(n) AS id ORDER BY id

name: wrapped-STARTS WITH
query: MATCH (n) WHERE toLower(toString(coalesce(n.caller_class,''))) STARTS WITH 'example.other' RETURN id(n) AS id ORDER BY id

name: raw-ENDS WITH
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name ENDS WITH 'other' RETURN id(n) AS id ORDER BY id

name: wrapped-ENDS WITH
query: MATCH (n) WHERE toLower(toString(coalesce(n.caller_class,''))) ENDS WITH 'example.other' RETURN id(n) AS id ORDER BY id

name: untyped-four-raw
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_class CONTAINS 'other' OR n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' OR n.callee_class CONTAINS 'other' OR n.callee_name CONTAINS 'other' RETURN id(n) AS id ORDER BY id

name: untyped-four-wrapped
query: MATCH (n) WHERE toLower(toString(coalesce(n.caller_class,''))) CONTAINS 'other' OR toLower(toString(coalesce(n.caller_name,''))) CONTAINS 'other' OR toLower(toString(coalesce(n.callee_class,''))) CONTAINS 'other' OR toLower(toString(coalesce(n.callee_name,''))) CONTAINS 'other' RETURN id(n) AS id ORDER BY id

name: typed-four-raw
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_class CONTAINS 'other' OR n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' OR n.callee_class CONTAINS 'other' OR n.callee_name CONTAINS 'other' RETURN id(n) AS id ORDER BY id

name: typed-four-wrapped
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE toLower(toString(coalesce(n.caller_class,''))) CONTAINS 'other' OR toLower(toString(coalesce(n.caller_name,''))) CONTAINS 'other' OR toLower(toString(coalesce(n.callee_class,''))) CONTAINS 'other' OR toLower(toString(coalesce(n.callee_name,''))) CONTAINS 'other' RETURN id(n) AS id ORDER BY id

name: empty-null-wrapper
query: MATCH (n) WHERE coalesce(n.caller_name,'') CONTAINS '' RETURN id(n) AS id ORDER BY id

name: raw-empty
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS '' RETURN id(n) AS id ORDER BY id

name: or-overlap-count
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name='other' OR n.callee_name='invoke' RETURN count(n) AS count

name: distinct-provenance
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name='other' RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_class AS caller ORDER BY caller LIMIT 1

name: available-empty
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name='absent' RETURN id(n) AS id

name: half-surrogate
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_class CONTAINS '\ud800' RETURN id(n) AS id ORDER BY id

name: java-lower
query: MATCH (n) WHERE toLower(n.caller_class) CONTAINS 'i\u0307d' RETURN id(n) AS id ORDER BY id

name: lower-rhs-unchanged
query: MATCH (n) WHERE toLower(n.caller_class) CONTAINS 'OTHER' RETURN id(n) AS id

name: parameter-string
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS $term RETURN id(n) AS id ORDER BY id

name: parameter-null
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS $term RETURN id(n) AS id ORDER BY id

name: parameter-number
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS $term RETURN id(n) AS id ORDER BY id

name: parameter-missing
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS $term RETURN id(n) AS id ORDER BY id

name: extra-argument
query: MATCH (n) WHERE toString(n.caller_name,1/0)='other' RETURN id(n) AS id ORDER BY id

name: throwing-fallback
query: MATCH (n) WHERE coalesce(n.caller_name,1/0)='other' RETURN id(n) AS id ORDER BY id

name: throwing-or
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name='other' OR substring('x','bad')='x' RETURN id(n) AS id ORDER BY id

name: incomplete-or
query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name='absent' OR true RETURN id(n) AS id ORDER BY id

name: optional
query: OPTIONAL MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name='absent' RETURN id(n) AS id

name: unwind
query: UNWIND ['other','caller'] AS term MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name=term RETURN term,id(n) AS id ORDER BY term,id

name: old-binding
query: WITH {caller_name:'other'} AS n MATCH (n) WHERE n.caller_name='other' RETURN n

name: inline-ordered
query: MATCH (n {id:-1,caller_name:1/0}) WHERE n.caller_name='other' RETURN id(n) AS id
